name: Mikhail Ramphet
source:
Georik's childhood friend and rival. As the captain of the Royal Guard, he takes his work very seriously.

"...has hobbies ranging from "going to church" to "harassing Georik into going to church." For a change of pace, he also likes to start barfights. He's theoretically Georik's best friend, but in a resentful, insecure, "why can't I be better than you?" way."

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
